mapper.update: UPDATE member_report SET content = NULL, result_note = NULL WHERE status IN ('ACTIONED', 'DISMISSED') AND handled_at <= #{cutoff} AND (content IS NOT NULL OR result_note IS NOT NULL) LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE sanction SET reason = NULL WHERE reason IS NOT NULL AND ( (status = 'EXPIRED' AND ends_at <= #{cutoff}) OR (status = 'LIFTED' AND lifted_at <= #{cutoff}) OR (type = 'WARNING' AND status <> 'LIFTED' AND starts_at <= #{cutoff}) ) LIMIT #{limit}
